title_zh: 保留温暖的志愿者致辞故事并删去尴尬笑话

scenario.label_zh: 确定志愿者致辞的幽默边界
scenario.goal_zh: 选择不伤害当事人的轻松故事，删去失误笑话并以真实贡献结束致辞

context_zh: 美国社区活动的主持人向同事试读致敬退休志愿者的短致辞。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Vera
sentences.text: We're here to honor Pat's years of work, so I don't want the speech to sound like a roast.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: It can still have some humor. What about the time her dog joined the video meeting?

sentences.speaker: Vera
sentences.text: That was hilarious, and Pat tells the story herself. I'm less sure about the joke about her missing the bus.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Leave that out. A humorous story should make her feel included, not embarrassed.

sentences.speaker: Vera
sentences.text: I'll keep the dog story, then finish with what she did for the reading group.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Good. That gives people a smile and brings it back to why we're thanking her.

targets.sense_zh: 向某人致敬并表彰其贡献（美式拼写）
